Cotton gives me a cash crop, so I will keep some area in it, but not all, because it takes more field management and labor. Since some people in my household work off-farm, I will manage the land in a way that is practical, stable, and familiar to me. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it helps yield and stand establishment, keep fertilizer at a moderate working level, irrigate when the crop really needs it, and control pests enough to protect yield without making the work too heavy.
